confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are medium confidence. They come from secondary price sources (Numbeo, combien-coute, Bookiscout, Expatistan search snippets) rather than current Pula menus, and the sources are dated differently. The cocktail figure leans on an Expatistan page last updated in 2023. Peak-season uplift for July was applied as a judgement. Accommodation anchors are low confidence: they are holistic model estimates for peak-summer coastal Istria and were not checked against live listings. The RBA observation was taken from search summaries that cite rba.gov.au pages; the F11 table itself was not opened, and a third-party 16 October figure was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use Pula-specific aggregated price sources. Accommodation anchors are a holistic estimate for mid-sized coastal Croatian towns in peak July demand, with no comparable-city search performed. Euro-denominated figures were converted to USD at an approximate market rate.
